tools.name: check_circuit
tools.description: Checks whether a circuit is wired correctly: loose ends, parts with no power source, an LED with the wrong diode model, unknown parts, labels on top of parts. tools.name: simulate_circuit
tools.description: Simulates a circuit and returns the voltage across and current through every part once it settles, such as the current through an LED, the output of a voltage divider or whether a bulb lights. tools.name: design_circuit
tools.description: Designs an electronic circuit from a plain description, such as an LED with its resistor, a 555 timer blinker, a transistor switch, a voltage divider, or an Arduino or ESP32 breadboard project with its sketch. The design passes breadboardhub's structural checks, with one corrected attempt if needed;

tools.description: Changes an existing circuit as asked in plain words, such as "make the two resistors parallel", "add a voltmeter across the LED" or "use a 12V supply", or answers a question about it ("what does the 10 mH part do?"). tools.name: debug_circuit
tools.description: Finds why a circuit someone built does not work, such as an LED that stays off or a 555 that does not blink on a breadboard. tools.name: design_chip
tools.description: Designs digital logic in Verilog from a plain description, such as a 4-bit counter, a traffic light state machine or a logic circuit for an FPGA. tools.name: fix_chip
tools.description: Fixes Verilog that does not compile or gives warnings, such as syntax errors, width mismatches or unintended latches. Builds it with Yosys and Verilator, corrects it, and builds it again after each change. Returns the corrected code, anything still wrong, and a link that opens it with its diagram. C

tools.name: explain_chip
tools.description: Explains what a Verilog module does, in plain English: its inputs and outputs, its behaviour and anything unusual. Suits learning digital logic or reading FPGA code someone else wrote. Returns the explanation as text; nothing is built or changed. Counts toward the daily design limit.

tools.name: search_designs
tools.description: Searches the public circuit, firmware and schematic designs people have shared on breadboardhub, such as "ESP32 temperature sensor", "buck converter" or "Arduino motor driver". Returns each design's name, type, tags, stars and link. Free, with no daily limit.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Gets one public design shared on breadboardhub by its owner's username and its slug, both shown in search results and in design links (breadboardhub.com/<username>/<slug>). Returns its name, type, description, licence, tags, simulator and link. Free, with no daily limit.
